hero.title: Lawn & Garden Care, Delivered to Your Door
hero.subtitle: Professional, reliable landscaping in the comfort of your own property. Mowing, trimming, or a full garden cleanup — we come to you.

about.heading: About GreenCut
about.intro: GreenCut brings professional lawn and garden care directly to your property — no hassle, no mess left behind, just a great-looking outdoor space.
paragraphs: Our lawn and garden service was founded on a simple belief: a well-kept property shouldn't require hours of your weekend. Whether you need a weekly mow, a seasonal cleanup, or a full garden overhaul, we make it easy.

Each job is carried out by an experienced, fully equipped landscaper who takes the time to understand your property and preferences. Your garden plan is designed around your needs — not a one-size-fits-all approach.
about.landscaper_bio: Jamie is a qualified horticulturist and landscaper with years of experience across residential and commercial properties. Passionate about outdoor spaces, they founded GreenCut to give homeowners access to professional lawn care without the hassle.

services.name: Lawn Mowing
services.short: Regular mowing, edging, and blowing down of paths and driveways. Keeps your lawn neat, healthy, and looking its best.

services.name: Hedge & Shrub Trimming
services.short: Precision trimming of hedges, shrubs, and topiary. Clean lines, healthy growth, and a tidy finish every time.

services.name: Garden Cleanup
services.short: Clearing leaves, debris, weeds, and overgrowth. Perfect for seasonal resets or taking back an overgrown space.

services.name: Weed Control
services.short: Targeted hand-pulling and treatment to keep weeds out of lawns, beds, and paths. Recurring visits available.

services.name: Edging & Borders
services.short: Crisp, defined edges along paths, driveways, and garden beds. The finishing touch that makes a lawn look professional.

services.name: Lawn Treatment
services.short: Fertilising, aeration, and lawn health treatments. Build a lush, thick lawn that stays green all season.
